metadata.description: Community components, layouts, instruments, artifactories and spaces for the Dimension platform. Slots are open and layout-owned; well-known names are published conventions (doc 68 §4.1).

plugins.name: rail-t3
plugins.description: A T3-Code-style session rail: live cards, quiet rows, a settled shelf. A production alternative to rail-classic filling the well-known `rail` slot — the in-tree tier's worked example (react + three @fraym/ui values).

plugins.name: three-lane
plugins.description: A layout that declares its OWN slots (lane-left / lane-main / lane-dock / badge) and ships Demo Lane — the assembly-spine thesis demo: a space assembled from three plugins nobody hand-wired together.

plugins.name: mochi-mark
plugins.description: A mark component drawn in a declared slot of a plugin layout — the import-surface FLOOR: react only, zero @fraym/ui.

plugins.name: pulse-mark
plugins.description: The Store's demo component: a mark with zero Fraym UI reading `sessions/list` through the one granted binding, selector-gated to a single boolean — the zero-import tier demonstrated.

plugins.name: session-board
plugins.description: Sessions - mission control in the dock: every session partitioned by urgency (needs you / working / idle), one-click switching. The first contributed dock component ("type": "component", "slot": "dock"), at the zero-import floor.

plugins.name: thread-minimal
plugins.description: Minimal Thread - a compact transcript replacing the classic thread SECTION of the session surface by space binding (workspace.sections.thread, doc 69 §3.5). The first contributed thread section, at the zero-import floor: react only, facts from the Store's published session/<id>/transcript + verb cells.

plugins.name: composer-minimal
plugins.description: Minimal Composer - the session surface's composer SECTION at the zero-import floor: Enter sends, Shift+Enter newlines, and the control becomes Stop while the session streams. Reads the published session/<id>/isStreaming cell; sends ONLY through act("sendMessage") / act("stopSession"). Bound by workspace.sections.composer.

plugins.name: env-minimal
plugins.description: Minimal Environment - a pinned environment card for a workspace corner post: checkout identity, this session's SCM ledger and task roll-up, drawn from the host props the shell already publishes. Bound by widgets.pinned; react is the entire import surface.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: Forge - a LAYOUT declaring four slots plus the Forge space that assembles a coding surface ENTIRELY from marketplace parts (rail-t3, session-board, mochi-mark, thread-minimal, composer-minimal, env-minimal). The workspace host filling forge-main is the one non-marketplace piece, stated on purpose.
